lean.statement: ∀ {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (mu : Measure X) [SigmaFinite mu] (f g : X → ℝ), Measurable f → Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (f x)) mu → Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (g x)) mu → llr (mu.tilted f) (mu.tilted g) =ᵐ[mu.tilted f] fun x => f x - Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (f z) ∂mu) - g x + Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (g z) ∂mu)
approved_definition_context: A tilted measure is the normalized exponential reweighting of a base measure when the exponential weight is integrable.
llr denotes Mathlib's selected measurable real log-likelihood-ratio representative.
An equality marked =ᵐ[m] holds almost everywhere with respect to the measure m.
SigmaFinite is the standard sigma-finiteness typeclass for a measure.
